text:
Nora M: FYI — kickoff for Marketplace SSO+SCIM + HSM integration with SecureKey. Goal: pilot with 3 customers and Marketplace listing by 2026-06-01. Primary contacts: Sam (SSO/SCIM), Diego (KMS/HSM), Nora (partner PM). Call out immediate risks.

Sam R: ack. SAML flow: partner wants IdP-initiated + SP-initiated. We'll expose SAML metadata endpoint + support HTTP-POST binding. Question: do we enforce signed assertions or allow both signed and unsigned?

Diego P: recommend enforcing signed assertions and encrypted assertions for prod. HSM notes: SecureKey requires HSM-backed key import (BYOK), expects KMIP v2 and PKCS#11. We should confirm key wrapping algorithm (RSA-OAEP-256).

Nora M: LegalBot, any special clauses for BYOK with a marketplace vendor? Need to confirm liabilities & key custody language.

LegalBot: Flagged: BYOK clause must specify that vendor is not a custodian; customer retains key ownership and liability. Also require SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence from vendor. ETA for legal review: 2026-04-15.

Sam R: For SCIM provisioning, partner will push group changes. Proposed rate limit: 10 requests/s with burst 50 for 5s. Also provide paged list support with `startIndex`+`count`. Sample SCIM user payload we'll accept: {"userName":"jdoe","externalId":"123","active":true,"emails":[{"value":"jdoe@example.com"}],"groups":[{"value":"eng","display":"Engineering"}]}

Diego P: Acceptance tests I want: 1) BYOK import flow using encrypted key blobs 2) Live signing and rotate keys without downtime 3) Failover to software-backed KMS if HSM offline. I'll draft test harness.

Nora M: Marketplace listing: short description + features: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, BYOK (HSM), Secrets sync, SI-led onboarding. Need screenshots and a 60s explainer video. Marketing deadline: 2026-05-10 to prep announcement for 2026-06-01.

Sam R: Ops note: we'll expose a staging SAML endpoint for partners at https://staging.redwood.ai/integrations/securekey/saml. Need cert for that — can we use wildcard staging cert?

Diego P: Use staging cert for demo, prod needs customer-specific client certs. CSR example I'll upload. Also, HSM connection string will look like: `kmip://hsm01.securekey.net:5696?slot=2&module=pkcs11` — ensure network egress rules allow 5696/tcp.

Nora M: Security ask: we must document audit log schema for key ops and SCIM events. Who owns that?

Sam R: I'll own SCIM event log schema. Fields: event_type, user_id, actor, timestamp, status, error_code. Will post draft by 2026-04-01.

Diego P: I'll own key ops audit: key_id, operation (import/rotate/delete/use), actor, hsm_slot, result, timestamp. Draft by 2026-04-03.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Network ACL update scheduled 2026-03-28 04:00 UTC to open outbound 5696/tcp to securekey test subnet.

Nora M: Pilot plan: week 1 — integration smoke tests with partner (staging), week 2 — three pilot customers onboarding, week 3 — run acceptance tests, week 4 — freeze and prepare marketplace assets. Pilot kickoff target: 2026-05-04.

Sam R: Blocker: one partner IdP uses nonstandard NameID format. Need to add support for `persistent` + fallback to `email` claim. Will add to compatibility matrix.

Diego P: Blocker: SecureKey HSM team requested direct IP allowlist, not CIDR. Ops can support but need exact IPs. Nora, can you get those?

Nora M: on it — I'll get IPs and provide by 2026-03-26. Also scheduling weekly syncs Tues 10am PT starting 2026-03-30.

Sam R: small snippet for metadata endpoint (WIP): ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.ai/saml/securekey">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>...<KeyDescriptor use="signing">...certificate...</KeyDescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Will publish full metadata and rotation docs.

Diego P: BYOK CSR sample (PEM): ```
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----
MIIBVTCB...
-----END CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----
```
Uploading to drive.

Nora M: Action items: Nora get IP allowlist by 2026-03-26; Sam publish SAML metadata + SCIM log schema by 2026-04-01; Diego upload CSR + acceptance tests by 2026-04-03; Legal review by 2026-04-15; Marketing assets by 2026-05-10. React with :eyes: when you've read.
